items.titleZh: 勒克莱尔采访说漏法拉利引擎规格，新闻官在一旁急得摇头
items.summaryZh: 阿塞拜疆大奖赛后接受天空体育意大利台采访时，查尔斯·勒克莱尔被问赛车是否装了法拉利最新规格的第二版动力单元（ADUO 2）。他答：「我用的是最新规格。」随即瞄了新闻官一眼，补充道：「不知道我是不是说了不该说的，不过我以为你们都知道了。」镜头拍到新闻官一脸慌张地摇头。
items.originalTitle: Charles Leclerc gives too much away about Ferrari engine in awkward interview after Azerbaijan GP
detailZh: 阿塞拜疆大奖赛后，查尔斯·勒克莱尔在法拉利引擎的问题上说得有点多了。
阿塞拜疆大奖赛结束后，查尔斯·勒克莱尔似乎透露了比法拉利车队希望公开的更多引擎信息。
周六巴库那场跌宕起伏的比赛结束后，勒克莱尔接受天空体育意大利台采访时，他与新闻官之间一段既好笑又尴尬的互动被镜头捕捉了下来。
勒克莱尔被问到他的赛车是否装上了法拉利最新规格的第二版动力单元（ADUO 2）。当他脱口承认确实如此时，他的新闻官显得十分慌张，一直在摇头。
「我用的是最新规格。」勒克莱尔回答，随后和新闻官短暂对视了一眼，又补充道：「我不知道自己是不是说了不该说的。不过我以为你们都知道了。」
这对法拉利来说又是一场令人失望的比赛，勒克莱尔在排位赛中展现的希望没能转化为正赛成绩。
尽管落后杆位八成秒，勒克莱尔仍拿到了与乔治·拉塞尔并排的前排发车位，但他起步后立刻被迈凯伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里超越，也缺乏挑战领跑者的速度。
勒克莱尔最终获得第四，队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿同样度过了一个艰难的下午，只拿到平平无奇的第六名。
这位摩纳哥车手坚称，法拉利需要带来更多升级，才能缩小与梅赛德斯的差距，而迈凯伦和红牛等车队近期都取得了令人印象深刻的进步。
「他们非常强，」勒克莱尔谈到梅赛德斯时说，「迈凯伦也很强——也许没有红牛那么强，但红牛尤其强。我们知道他们的动力单元非常强，所以这是一场适合他们的比赛，但即便如此。
「我们落后梅赛德斯挺多，落后红牛挺多，也稍稍落后迈凯伦——这些都是我们的竞争对手，而且这不是什么新情况。已经有好几场比赛我们都在被他们一点点拉开，所以我们必须作出反应，带来升级，把差距再缩小回来。」
法拉利今年争夺F1世界冠军的希望似乎已经破灭，这支马拉内罗车队在车队世界锦标赛中落后梅赛德斯160分。
车手积分榜上，刘易斯·汉密尔顿仍排第三，但已落后领跑者安德烈亚·基米·安东内利103分，也被乔治·拉塞尔追近。勒克莱尔排第五，落后汉密尔顿20分。
（来源：Crash.net，原文作者：刘易斯·拉卡姆）
detailEn: Charles Leclerc said more than he should have about Ferrari's engine after the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
Charles Leclerc appears to have shared more information about Ferrari’s engine than the Formula 1 team wanted after the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
An amusing and awkward exchange between Leclerc and his press officer was captured during an interview with Sky Italy after Saturday’s dramatic race in Baku.
Leclerc was asked whether his car was fitted with Ferrari’s latest-spec ADUO 2 power unit. When he let slip that this was the case, his press officer was seen looking panicked and shaking her head.
“I had the latest specification,” Leclerc answered, before sharing a brief look at his press officer and adding: "I don’t know if I’m saying something I shouldn’t. But I thought you knew.”
It proved to be another disappointing race for Ferrari as Leclerc’s qualifying promise failed to translate into the grand prix.

Having secured a front-row start alongside George Russell despite being eight tenths adrift of pole position, Leclerc immediately lost a place to McLaren’s Oscar Piastri and lacked the pace to challenge the front runners.
Leclerc eventually finished fourth, with team-mate Lewis Hamilton also enduring a difficult afternoon on his way to taking an underwhelming sixth.
The Monegasque insisted that Ferrari need to bring more upgrades in order to close the gap to Mercedes, while the likes of McLaren and Red Bull have made impressive recent gains.

“They were very strong,” Leclerc said of Mercedes. “McLaren were also strong – not maybe as strong as Red Bull, but Red Bull were particularly strong. We know they have a very strong power unit so this is a good race for them, but still.

“We were quite far off Mercedes, far off Red Bull, a bit behind McLaren – these are our competitors and it’s not new. It’s [been] quite a few races now that we’re losing a little bit of track to them, so it's important that we react to that and that we bring upgrades in order to close the gap again.”
Any hopes of Ferrari contending for an F1 world title this year appear to be over, with the Maranello squad 160 points down on Mercedes in the constructors’ world championship.

In the drivers’ standings, Lewis Hamilton remains third but has slipped to 103 points behind championship leader Andrea Kimi Antonelli and also lost ground to George Russell. Leclerc sits fifth, 20 points behind Hamilton.
Source: Crash.net (Lewis Larkam). Original article: https://www.crash.net/f1/news/1105808/1/charles-leclerc-gives-too-much-away-about-ferrari-engine-awkward-interview

items.originalTitle: Charles Leclerc: “McLaren and Red Bull did a step forward that we didn’t do”
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc believes Red Bull now has a clear chassis advantage over Ferrari, while McLaren has also improved markedly, following the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
detailZh: 夏尔·勒克莱尔：“迈凯伦和红牛迈出了我们没有迈出的那一步”
法拉利在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上过得艰难，因为对手F1车队为巴库带来了大量升级
勒克莱尔在F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛结束后认为，红牛如今在底盘性能方面对法拉利拥有明显优势，而迈凯伦也有了显著进步。
这两支车队都为巴库带来了重要的升级套件，重点集中在侧箱、底板和扩散器上——迈凯伦的升级还包括修改后的引擎盖、后悬架和尾翼，而红牛的升级则包含新的后视镜和座舱保护环（halo）。与此同时，法拉利的赛车则保持原样未做改动。
勒克莱尔在排位赛中惊险地锁定了头排发车位置，在第三节排位赛中以0.001秒的优势击败迈凯伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，并以0.137秒的优势击败红牛的伊萨克·哈贾尔。然而，这位摩纳哥车手到第四圈时已经远远落后于第五位；他最终能获得第四名，要归功于皮亚斯特里在一号弯刹车过晚冲出弯道的失误，以及基米·安东内利在排位赛中发生撞车、不得不从第16位发车在车阵中苦苦追赶。
“对我们来说，这场比赛有点无聊，”勒克莱尔说。“不幸的是，我们起步很糟糕，这可能是今天我们唯一能做得好得多的事情。在那之后，我们完全没有速度。和红牛相比，防守非常困难，因为我们的直道速度太慢了。”
“我们目前在原始速度上就是很挣扎。”
他补充道：“两辆红牛太快了，显然乔治·拉塞尔也相当强势。”
队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿对法拉利速度不足的问题则没有那么健谈。当被问到车队现在是否拥有第四快的赛车时，这位七届世界冠军回答道：“这有什么重要的？”
当Motorsport.com进一步追问红牛的速度有多么出人意料时——尽管马克斯·维斯塔潘在排位赛中落后1.6秒，却仍然挑战了乔治·拉塞尔的冠军，而伊萨克·哈贾尔在第三节排位赛中比梅赛德斯慢了一秒——汉密尔顿回应道：“我真的不会去想其他任何人。”
虽然勒克莱尔认为巴库赛道并不适合法拉利，但这位28岁的车手相信，SF-26这个周末表现不佳——尽管16号赛车再次使用了ADUO2动力单元——是因为对手们带来了升级。
“迈凯伦和红牛凭借他们带来的升级向前迈了一步，”他说。“他们最近进步了，向前迈出了我们没有做到的一步。而我们必须做出反应，因为现在损失一些速度之后要追回来会非常困难。所以希望我们能很快做出反应。”
研发显然受到预算上限和空气动力学测试限制的制约，但勒克莱尔表示，法拉利“即将有一些新东西带来”。
“至于这是否足以缩小差距，由于不知道其他车队还藏有什么底牌，那就是另一回事了，”他补充道，“但可以肯定的是，我们有一些新东西应该能帮助我们向前迈进一步。”
detailEn: Charles Leclerc: “McLaren and Red Bull did a step forward that we didn’t do”
Ferrari had a tough Azerbaijan GP, as rival F1 teams brought substantial upgrades to Baku
Red Bull now has a clear advantage over Ferrari in terms of chassis performance, with McLaren having also markedly improved, Charles Leclerc believes following the Formula 1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

Both teams brought significant upgrade packages to Baku, focusing on the sidepods, floor and diffuser – McLaren’s also included a revised engine cover, rear suspension and rear wing while Red Bull’s featured new mirrors and halo. Meanwhile, Ferrari kept its car untouched.

Leclerc narrowly clinched a front-row spot on the grid, outpacing McLaren’s Oscar Piastri by 0.001s and Red Bull’s Isack Hadjar by 0.137s in Q3. However, the Monegasque faded to a distant fifth by lap four; he only finished fourth courtesy of a late mistake by Piastri, who ran deep into Turn 1, and Kimi Antonelli’s qualifying crash meaning he was fighting through the pack after starting 16th.

“It was a bit of a boring race for us,” Leclerc said. “Unfortunately, we had a bad start, which was probably the only thing we could have done much better today. After that, we just had no pace. Compared to the Red Bull, it was very difficult to defend because in the straight line we are too slow.
“We are just struggling with raw pace at the moment.”
He added: “The two Red Bulls were too quick and obviously George [Russell] was too strong as well.”

Team-mate Lewis Hamilton wasn’t as loquacious about Ferrari’s lack of speed. Asked if the Scuderia now had the fourth-fastest car, the seven-time world champion replied: “What’s the importance of that?”

Pressed by Motorsport.com on how unexpected Red Bull’s pace was – after Max Verstappen challenged George Russell for victory despite qualifying 1.6s down while Isack Hadjar was a second slower than the Mercedes in Q3 – Hamilton responded: “I don't really think about anybody else.”

While Leclerc doesn’t think the Baku track suits the Ferrari, the 28-year-old believes the SF-26’s lack of performance this weekend – despite running the ADUO2 power unit again on the #16 car – was down to the rivals' updates.

“McLaren and Red Bull did a step forward with the upgrades they are bringing,” he said. “They have grown recently, they did a step forward that we didn't do. And we must react, because losing some pace now is going to be very difficult to take it back. So hopefully we can react very soon.”
Development is obviously limited by the budget cap and the aerodynamic testing restrictions, but Ferrari has “a few things coming”, Leclerc indicated.

“Whether it's going to be enough to close the gap, not knowing what the others have in store as well is another matter,” he added. “But surely, we've got a few things that should help us do some steps forward.”
keyPointsZh: 两支对手车队都在巴库带来了重要升级包，重点集中在侧箱、底板和扩散器
迈凯伦的升级还包括修改后的引擎盖、后悬挂和尾翼
